author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE.

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0.
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib routing: 15/15 pass.
- cargo test -p polaris-types --lib routing: 6/6 pass.
- cargo xtask check-frontend-boundary: 0 violations.

Subagent kept dispatch tight (57 tool calls). Pure routing function: route(&RoutingSnapshot) -> RoutingDecision, no I/O, fully unit-testable. Closed RoutingCategory enum added to polaris-types for stable §5.4 hard rules; existing open-string ReportCategory unchanged. SOFT_LOAD_CAP=8, easy-mode categories Spam+Copyright, deterministic tiebreaker cascade. Property test proves CSAM-without-trained-mods always forwards.
